title: Stopping a cloud job throws away an image already paid for
description: Cloud Stop (js/services/cloudExecutor.js) only aborts the client fetch; DeepInfra finishes and bills the run, and routes/deepinfra.js still saves the output to %TEMP%/cubric-deepinfra, but the gallery has already dropped the job so no card is made. Proven 2026-09-25 (Fabio Stopped a Flux Pro run; aa9dca8b-...jpg landed with no card). DECIDED 2026-09-25 (Fabio): option A - the paid result lands as a normal card marked already charged, matching the local R09 keep-after-Stop path. See plan.md. Do together with MPI-929. Found under MPI-908.
